required_question: State the legal provider name, performing facility and responsible technical contact.
Confirm willingness to receive six exact unpowered ROBOTIS articles and keep J1/J2 kits segregated.
Confirm that no power source, U2D2, actuator cable, encoder read or powered motion is required or permitted.
Describe inbound inspection, quarantine, serial/lot capture, photography and chain-of-custody controls.
List every proposed CMM, scanner, balance, angle reference and fixture by manufacturer/model/serial.
Provide current calibration certificates, calibration due dates and traceability chain for each instrument.
Provide the current ISO/IEC 17025 certificate and scope, and identify exactly which quoted results fall inside or outside it.
Propose the datum realization and method for the actuator axis and H101/S102 fixed/moving axial faces.
Propose the received mounting-depth and attachment-feature measurement method without inferring thread purpose or load capacity.
Propose an external mechanical angle datum and repeated bidirectional unpowered backlash method; do not use encoder data.
Describe a non-damaging restraint that does not load the actuator case, connector, cable aperture, unapproved thread or candidate stop surface.
Confirm no screw will enter an actuator until a separately signed screw/length/depth/spacer/torque/reuse instruction is received.
State whether the provider can execute the later signed temporary assembly and teardown instruction with calibrated torque tools.
Provide a measurement-specific uncertainty budget and coverage factor for each numeric deliverable.
State scanner point spacing, verified volumetric error over the article, registration method and verification artifact.
State how hand-positioned poses will be supported without forcing an angle or using the actuator/fixture as a stop.
Provide native/raw CMM and scan files, point clouds, CSV results, coordinate transforms, residuals and processing logs.
Provide original scale-bearing photographs and permit SHA-256 hashing of every delivered file.
Describe stop-work, damage, discrepancy and nonconformance reporting plus article quarantine rules.
Describe post-measurement teardown, thread/frame/case/washer/spacer inspection, re-inventory and return packaging.
Provide itemized fixed/not-to-exceed price, assumptions, shipping, insurance, tax, lead time and quote expiration.
State whether remote or in-person witness of setup and critical measurements is available and priced.
State data retention, confidentiality, subcontracting and deletion/return policy; identify all subcontractors.
Acknowledge that the work is unpowered evidence acquisition only and supplies no fabrication, motion, safety or energization approval.
